description: International Airlines - Airline by country of port data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Scheduled operations of international airlines operating to and from Australia. Data on Passengers, freight and mail carried by airline by uplift/discharge country within single flight number services. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are airlines, australia, australian aviation statistics, aviation, country. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
